title: Eventual consistency violation in data replication
description: Distributed database replication that doesn't guarantee eventual consistency

mutation.content:
---- MODULE BenchReplication ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLES primary, replica
Init == primary = 0 /\ replica = 0
Write == primary < 3 /\ primary' = primary + 1 /\ replica' = replica
Sync == replica' = primary /\ primary' = primary
Next == Write \/ Sync
Consistent == primary = replica
vars == <<primary, replica>>
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====
mutation.description: Async-replication model where a Write leaves primary ahead of replica — the Consistent invariant (primary = replica) is reachably violated before Sync

expected_outcome.description: nf:solve model_check layer detects the reachable Consistent-invariant violation via TLC.
